If anyone can do this, it's Han and Leia Solo.''"
"''I don't think you can promise that. Even Grandpa and Grandma don't usually fly ''into'' the middle of a Sith ambush—at least not on purpose.|Tenel Ka Djo and her daughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]]|}} The '''evacuation''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] was the action taken by the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] in response to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s seizure of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Under the leadership of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kam Solusar]] and [[Tionne Solusar]] and the crew of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the students, staff, and families present at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on Ossus evacuated the planet while the forces of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] under the command of [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]] defended the evacuees from a group of Sith pilots. The entire academy was being evacuated, which included 322 students, 923 family members, and approximately 1,200 support staff. ==Appearances== *''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'' {{Ab|Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse (audiobook)}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{LostTribeEmergenceNav}} {{Interlang |de=Scharmützel von Ossus (44 NSY) |pl=Bitwa nad Ossusem }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence), evacuation of}} [[Category:Battles of Ossus]] [[Category:Battles of the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]] [[Category:Evacuations]]
